headline: Shared proposals and clearer revision discussions.
highlights: Both app and notification reminders stay available outside chat for quick access.
Rehearsal and Sunday Service proposals share one linked plan, so updates stay together.
Discussion viewers keep their history, and authors count as having seen their own updates.
Submitted proposals no longer show the initial overdue reminder; pending ribbons and day counts continue through revisions.
Attached guides use the same readable sections in revision requests and discussions.
Readable lyrics are required for proposal submission, and lyrics from chord charts appear in the lyrics editor and checker.
